address: Shop B&C, GF, Keng Fong Hou Teng, 319 Avenida do Dr. Rodrigo Rodrigues, Macau, Macau
bio: With ribbed vaults as grand as a Gothic cathedral, it also boasts dark wood flooring, wall panels and furniture for added warmth and richness. Quality ingredients from around the world are crafted into fusion Thai dishes. Examples include spicy raw shrimp salad featuring Obsiblue from New Caledonia, or heart of palm red curry with Iberian pork collar from Spain. For a sweet finale, go for the fruity, fluffy mango soufflé pancake roll....
